message.content:
When it comes to jazz singing, several artists stand out as some of the best and most influential. Here’s a list of top jazz vocalists who have left a lasting impact on the genre:

| Artist | Notable Contributions |
|--------|-----------------------|
| **Ella Fitzgerald** | Known as the “First Lady of Song,” she was celebrated for her pure tone, impeccable diction, and improvisational scat singing. |
| **Billie Holiday** | Her emotive phrasing and unique voice made her one of the most iconic jazz singers of all time. |
| **Sarah Vaughan** | With a rich, operatic voice and incredible range, she earned the nickname “Sassy.” |
| **Nat King Cole** | A smooth baritone who blended jazz with pop sensibilities, becoming a crossover star. |
| **Nina Simone** | Though often associated with soul and blues, her jazz roots and powerful voice made her a standout performer. |
| **Cassandra Wilson** | Known for her deep, husky voice and innovative interpretations of jazz standards. |
| **Diana Krall** | A contemporary jazz pianist and vocalist known for her sultry voice and sophisticated arrangements. |
| **Tony Bennett** | A classic crooner whose jazz standards and collaborations with other legends keep him relevant. |
| **Michael Bublé** | A modern artist who blends traditional jazz with contemporary pop. |
| **Esperanza Spalding** | A bassist and vocalist who brings fresh, experimental elements to jazz. |

These artists represent different eras and styles within jazz, each bringing their own unique voice and artistry to the genre. If you’re looking for a particular style or era, let me know, and I can narrow down the recommendations!
